entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. To place a new order, press two. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse and it's just not for me. I need a return label.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, let me find the email. Hold on... Okay, it's VF-98765.
Got it, VF-98765. I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. And you'd like to return it?
Yes. How much time do I have to send it back once I get the label?
Our **standard policy** is actually very generous. You have **90 days** from the delivery date to make a return. You have **plenty of time**, so **don't worry**.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. Okay, perfect. Can you just email me the label then?
Of course. I'm creating that for you right now... hmm. That's odd. The system isn't allowing me to generate the label.
What do you mean? You just said I have plenty of time. What's the problem?
I'm not sure, let me look into this. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold.
Thank you for your patience. I am so sorry, but I've made a mistake. I was quoting the return policy for our VeloFit bikes. For accessories like the VeloBand Pulse, the return window is 14 days.
Are you serious? You just told me I had 90 days! I'm one day over the limit because you gave me the wrong information! This is unacceptable.
I completely understand your frustration, and this is 100% my error. I sincerely apologize for the misinformation I provided.
An apology doesn't help me. So now I'm stuck with this thing because you don't know your own company's policies?

No, not at all. Because I gave you incorrect information, I am going to make a one-time exception and honor the return. I am personally overriding the system block now and processing the return for you.
You can do that? For real?

Yes, absolutely. The mistake was mine, and it's our responsibility to make it right. I've just pushed the return through. You should receive an email with the prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack the item up and drop it off.
Wow. Okay. I... thank you. I was about to get really angry, but thank you for fixing it.
Of course. It was my pleasure to resolve this for you, and again, my apologies for the mix-up. Will there be anything else today?
No, that's everything. I really appreciate your help. Thanks, Sam.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
